lines.text: Many learners say: Actually, I am studying English now.
Better: Right now, I am studying English.
Actually means in fact, not now.
Right now! I am busy right now.

data.wrong: Actually, I am studying English now.
data.right: Right now, I am studying English.
data.why: Actually means in fact, not now.

en.tip: False friend: “actually” means “en realidad”. For “now”, use “right now”.
en.caption: Careful with this false friend! Do not say “Actually, I am studying English now.”, say: “Right now, I am studying English.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
